machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory
scope: Cold-process native-C+ 1024x1024 prompt-to-PNG generation with the explicit community-template 25-step FlowMatch schedule and MPSGraph attention
step_count_provenance: 25 came from the Comfy-Org Qwen-Image-2.1 workflow template, not Qwen's official recommendation. The template itself says the official pipeline uses about 40-50 Euler steps; Qwen and Diffusers default to 40.

input.prompt: A blue ceramic teapot on a windowsill.

denoising.note: MPSGraph uses commitAndContinue, so the reported aggregate GPU timestamp covers fragments rather than the complete transformer workload. Wall time is authoritative.

power_state.before: Now drawing from AC Power; battery 95%; discharging; 7:27 remaining
power_state.after: Now drawing from AC Power; battery 87%; discharging; 6:07 remaining
power_state.interpretation: macOS reported mutually ambiguous source and battery states, so no plugged-versus-battery normalization is claimed.
